candidates.name: OSTN15 coordinate transformation tool
verified_facts: The OS coordinate transformation tool is intended to transform between GNSS-derived coordinates and OSGB36 National Grid with mean-sea-level based heights using current OS transformation resources.
Batch and software alternatives are provided for coordinate transformations.
semantic_limits: A successful coordinate transformation does not validate the accuracy, antenna processing, source observation, parcel geometry or terrain classification of the input measurement.

candidates.name: OSTN Update tool
verified_facts: The OSTN Update tool converts OSGB36 coordinates derived with OSTN02/OSGM02 by back-transforming to ETRS89 and then forward-transforming with current OSTN15/OSGM15.
OS notes that the utility does not include the relatively small OS Net v2001 to v2009 station-coordinate shift.
semantic_limits: Legacy-coordinate migration is not a new survey and does not remove input GNSS, source-data or parcel-sampling uncertainty; model-version provenance must remain explicit.
